visual_logic.surface_detail: Dark 'Whale-Grey' skin with a tactile, leathery quality. Minimal patterning to emphasize its gargantuan scale.
visual_logic.anatomy_focus: Hero focus on the 'toothless' suction-feeding snout and the massive, barrel-shaped torso; dwarfism of the flippers relative to the body size.
visual_logic.environment: Deep Triassic ocean waters with low-angle light rays to emphasize the creature's 21-meter length.
visual_logic.pose: A vertical 'gulping' motion toward a swarm of Triassic squid, showcasing the lack of teeth and the expandable throat.
